explain.label: Explain bottle
explain.text: Read bottle `{bottle_id}` (use `bottle_context`). Summarize in 5 lines: project purpose, stack, what's actively being worked on, what's pending, critical decisions still in force.

explain.label: Explain prescription
explain.text: Load `prescription_context {rx_id}`. Explain chronologically what was decided, what was built, and what's pending. Cite pills by ID.

summary.label: Summary
summary.text: Summarize prescription `{rx_id}` in 3 sentences: goal, result, status.

reopen.label: Reopen to resume
reopen.text: Reopen prescription `{rx_id}` with `prescription_reopen` and start `/sdd:continue` from the appropriate phase.

explain.label: Explain pill
explain.text: Read pill `{pill_id}`. Explain what it says, why it was decided that way (search related proposal/architecture pills), and which pills reference it.

audit.label: Audit against code
audit.text: Read pill `{pill_id}` and verify each claim against the real codebase. Report: confirmed / contradicted / not found, with paths and line numbers. If the pill is obsolete, propose `pill_revise` with an updated version or `pill_discard` with justification — ask for confirmation before applying.

improve.label: Improve pill
improve.text: Read pill `{pill_id}`. Rewrite it following the content rules (lead with `Purpose:`/`Decision:`/`Rule:`, ~400 chars, no narrative prose, cite IDs instead of re-describing). Apply via `pill_revise` after confirmation.

explain.label: Explain capsule
explain.text: Read capsule `{capsule_id}`. Explain what preference it defines, when it applies, and why it was saved.

apply.label: Apply now
apply.text: Read capsule `{capsule_id}` and apply it to the current work in this project. If it conflicts with anything in the bottle, warn before acting.
